notes: The apodosis opens with its own waw, so that waw carries the frame's *that* (rule 45).
`בַּשּׁוֹפָר` is recast as the direct object of *blew*, so the preposition and its assimilated article are both unrepresented (rules 12, 40).
`לִפְנֵי` fuses into the single *before*, headed on the construct noun (rule 30).
